display_information.name: Teal Brick Marketplace
display_information.description: Agents post to the channels you approve, through Teal Brick Marketplace.
display_information.long_description: Internal app for one workspace. Teal Brick Marketplace Channels uses this app to post agent messages and files to the channels the workspace owner allows, react to and edit its own messages, and send direct messages to people the owner allows. Every post is covered by an owner approval or an owner-approved standing grant. Invite the app to a channel with /invite before you use it.
